train_gradient_boosting_quantile: train a GradientBoostingRegressor with quantile loss to predict conditional percentiles
evaluate_prediction_intervals: evaluate a 90% prediction interval using the 5th and 95th quantile models on test data
measure_pinball_loss: measure mean pinball loss for quantile regression predictions at a given alpha value
compute_coverage_fraction: compute the coverage fraction of observations falling within predicted lower and upper bounds
tune_quantile_regressor: tune hyper-parameters of a quantile regressor using HalvingRandomSearchCV and pinball loss scoring
